title: A family of closed subsets of a quasi-compact space with the finite intersection property has nonempty intersection
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the finite-intersection form of quasi-compactness (author lemma at source lines 1940-1946, label lemma-intersection-closed-in-quasi-compact). The proof (source lines 1948-1961) is a clean contraposition: emptiness of the intersection becomes an open covering after complementation (proof lines 1949-1952), quasi-compactness yields a finite subcover, and complementing that subcover back produces a finite subfamily with empty intersection, contradicting the hypothesis (proof lines 1952-1960). The reformulation is used repeatedly later in the chapter, in particular for the spectral-space material. H2.
